title: Hollowmere Growth Partners III: fund fact sheet
brief: Fact sheet for HCP-01: growth equity strategy in mid-sized companies, vintage 2021, fund size 480m USD, investment period of five years, management fee 1.75 percent a year on commitments during the investment period, carry 20 percent over an 8 percent hurdle, term 10 years with two one-year extensions. State that 78 percent of commitments are called to date and the fund is investing.

title: Hollowmere Harbour Infrastructure II: fund fact sheet
brief: Fact sheet for HCP-02: infrastructure income strategy (ports, storage and transport links), vintage 2018, fund size 350m EUR, reports in euro, management fee 1.25 percent a year on invested capital, carry 15 percent over a 6 percent hurdle, term 12 years. State that the fund is harvesting and 96.5 percent of commitments are called.

title: Hollowmere Credit Partners I: fund fact sheet
brief: Fact sheet for HCP-03: private credit strategy lending to mid-sized companies, vintage 2023, fund size 220m USD, management fee 1.0 percent a year on invested capital, carry 12.5 percent over a 7 percent hurdle, term 7 years. State that 41.5 percent of commitments are called and the fund is investing.

title: Hollowmere Real Assets Fund II: fund fact sheet
brief: Fact sheet for HCP-04: real assets strategy (logistics buildings and land), vintage 2016, fund size 260m USD, management fee 1.5 percent a year on net invested capital, carry 20 percent over an 8 percent hurdle, term 10 years with two one-year extensions. State that the fund is harvesting and 99.2 percent of commitments are called.

title: Capital call notice: HCP-01, Call 9
brief: Formal notice for HCP-01 Call 9: 6.0 percent of each investor's commitment, notice date 2026-10-12, due date 2026-10-26, wire cut-off 15:00 on the due date, purpose follow-on investments in two portfolio companies and the Q4 management fee. Late payment interest 9 percent a year, simple, counted daily. State that wire instructions appear only on the portal and are confirmed by call-back.

title: Capital call notice: HCP-03, Call 4
brief: Formal notice for HCP-03 Call 4: 8.5 percent of commitment, notice date 2026-11-02, due date 2026-11-16, wire cut-off 15:00 on the due date, purpose new loan originations and fund expenses. Cumulative called after this call stated as 41.5 percent. Late payment interest 9 percent a year.

title: Distribution notice: HCP-02
brief: Distribution notice for HCP-02: 3.20 EUR per unit from asset sale proceeds, record date 2026-10-30, payment date 2026-11-13, split 70 percent return of capital and 30 percent gains. Explain that the notice does not cover tax treatment and investors should consult their own advisers.

title: Distribution notice: HCP-04
brief: Distribution notice for HCP-04: 2.10 USD per unit from property sale proceeds, record date 2026-11-27, payment date 2026-12-11, split 55 percent return of capital and 45 percent gains. State that payment goes to the bank account on file in the portal.

title: Glossary of fund terms
brief: Plain-language definitions of NAV, commitment, called capital, distribution, carried interest (carry), hurdle (preferred return), clawback and J-curve. Give the Hollowmere funds' carry and hurdle examples where helpful (HCP-01 20 percent over 8 percent, HCP-03 12.5 percent over 7 percent).

title: Investor reporting calendar
brief: Quarterly statements are posted 45 days after quarter end (Q3 2026 by 2026-11-14), audited annual accounts 120 days after year end, capital call notices 14 days before the due date, distribution notices at least 10 business days before the payment date. State the portal posting time of 9:00.

title: Notice delivery and investor portal guide
brief: How notices reach investors: posted to the investor portal at 9:00 on the notice date with a portal alert; investors can choose portal only or portal plus courier copy; how to change preferences (through the investor relations desk, takes effect within five business days). State that bank detail changes need a signed form uploaded to the portal.

title: Transfer of interests policy
brief: Rules for transferring a limited partner interest: written consent of the general partner, 30 days notice, transferee must pass onboarding checks, administrative fee 2,500 USD per approved transfer, no transfers during a pending capital call period of 10 business days around the due date, unfunded commitment passes to the transferee.

title: Default and late payment policy
brief: What happens when a capital call is paid late: interest 9 percent a year, simple, counted daily from the due date; after 10 business days a default notice is sent; after a further 10 business days remedies include reduced distributions and forced sale of the interest. State the 15:00 wire cut-off.

title: How distributions are split
brief: Explains the order of a distribution: return of capital to investors first, then preferred return up to the hurdle (6 to 8 percent depending on fund), then catch-up and carry. Explains how a notice shows the return of capital share and what it means for the investor's remaining cost basis, without giving tax advice. Uses HCP-02's 70/30 split as an example.

title: Investor relations desk guide
brief: What the desk handles and does not: notices, statements, document requests and preference changes; no investment, tax or legal advice. Hours Monday to Friday, 9:00 to 17:00, closed on public holidays. Explains security rules: no bank detail changes through chat, wire instructions only from portal notices, and what to do if an investor suspects a fake request.
